evaluation_protocol.scope: Paired development evaluation, same nominal robot and initial states. High-speed commands do not by themselves demonstrate a running gait.

selection.scope: Nominal case selection only; changed-heading checks and visual review remain separate.
selection.criteria_scope: Project-defined command tracking thresholds, fixed before this model comparison.

video_scope: Isaac Lab physical rollout states rendered with verified Unitree geometry; no dynamics reintegration or motion editing.
remaining: Reliable tracking throughout the full speed range
Natural walking/running transitions and foot contact
selected_model_scope: Historical speed/yaw selection only; superseded by failed gait review.

gait_review.source: Saved native Isaac Lab physical states before reset

root_cause_1.name: AMP discriminator paused by saturation protection
root_cause_1.note: 框架自带机制，非用户改动；解除后抬脚问题解决

root_cause_3.name: reference motion library has no sustained slow walking
root_cause_3.consequence: 0.3 m/s 门槛需要新增参考数据，不能靠调参达成

visual_review.blocking_finding: 手臂全程不摆动；肩关节俯仰幅度只有专家走路的 9%—16%

evaluation_reproducibility.rule: 最终候选必须单独排第一位重新评估后才进入人工复核
